messages:
marco: FYI — escalated ticket from Acme. Their integration started getting function-call 400s. Customer says this started after a prompt tweak on their side, but errors only show up when the model calls the charge_tool.
sam: Attaching the error snippet from our logs: `func_call_validation_error: schema mismatch: amount expected number, got string`
marco: Key bit: our router is rejecting the tool args because the JSON body includes currency suffixes. Example from their payload: ```json
{"user_id": 9234, "amount": "120 USD", "currency": "USD"}
```
sam: They claim they didn't change the function definition. They did update system prompt few-shot examples to show human-friendly amounts (e.g., "120 USD").
elaine: Likely cause: system/fewshot examples are getting appended into the model context and the model is now emitting the amount with the currency token as part of the numeric field. Our function schema requires a numeric `amount` (type: number). When the model synthesizes args to match examples it includes the suffix which breaks validation.
anna: Can repro locally with their prompt bundle. Repro steps: 1) use model gpt-3x-instruct with their system prompt + 2 fewshot examples (examples include "120 USD"). 2) call charge_tool via function calling. 3) observe returned args. Example curl to repro: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"gpt-3x-instruct","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful payments assistant. Examples: 'Charge 120 USD to card...'."},{"role":"user","content":"Charge 120 to card id:C123"}],"functions":[{"name":"charge_tool","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"number"},"card_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["amount","card_id"]},"call":true}]}'```
elaine: Quick mitigation options: 1) instruct customer to remove currency tokens from few-shot examples (preferred), 2) temporarily relax validation for `amount` to allow numeric strings and coerce, 3) router-side sanitization where we strip common currency suffixes before schema validation.
marco: Customer asks for a hotfix because it's blocking billing. Can we provide a short-term router patch?
elaine: We can push a conservative sanitizer in the request pipeline: if schema expects number and we get string matching `^\\d+(\\.\\d+)?\s*(USD|usd|EUR|eur)$` coerce to number and keep currency in separate header. I'll open a small PR to eng-runtime.
sre-bot: Deploy scheduled: eng-runtime/sanitizer v0.1 -> canary in us-west in 15m if approved.
anna: Also flagged: there are a couple of customer routes with pinned model versions that include sticky system prompts. Recommend we surface a warning in Console when examples include currency-like tokens for numeric params.
sam: I'll relay the short-term patch and ask customer to remove currency from examples. Also capturing repro bundle in the ticket for eng.
marco: Thanks — please add the ticket ID to the PR description and tag @elaine for review. If sanitizer causes any unintended coercion we should have a failsafe to reject rather than mutate.
elaine: Agreed. We'll log all coerced args to a debug stream and keep original payload in audit. Planning PR now.
sam: Customer is on a billing-critical path and asked for ETA. Can we do a canary in 2 hours?
anna: Canary in 15m -> monitor for false positives 30m -> full rollout if clean. ETA ~2h.
marco: Leaving notes on the ticket about longer-term: update our function docs to call out that examples should match schema types, and add a Console lint that detects mismatched example tokens.
sam: Customer acknowledged. Closing loop once canary completes. :thumbsup:
